author: KEXP
description: Historic jazz heavyweights and friends of over fifty years, Kahil El'Zabar and David Murray come together to beam new light on the traditional form. With host Larry Mizell, Jr., the pair offer a performance of "One World Family" and more Live on KEXP.
title: Kahil El'Zabar and David Murray perform "One World Family" & more Live on KEXP
